title: Pagination drops the last item
issue: The pagination helper returns one item too few on every full page. Return exactly page_size items for a full page, preserve the existing input validation, and keep partial and empty pages correct.

demo_solution.rationale: The slice end is exclusive. Subtracting one truncates every full page.

title: Invoice totals round money incorrectly
issue: Invoice totals use binary floats and banker rounding. Money must round half up to two decimal places after applying the discount. Preserve negative credit totals and reject discounts outside 0 to 100.

demo_solution.after:
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
    subtotal = sum((Decimal(str(price)) for price in prices), Decimal("0"))
    discount = Decimal(str(discount_percent)) / Decimal("100")
    total = subtotal * (Decimal("1") - discount)
    return float(total.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
demo_solution.rationale: Decimal values created from strings avoid binary-float error. ROUND_HALF_UP handles positive payments and negative credits consistently.

title: Appointment times lose their timezone
issue: Appointment timestamps containing a timezone offset are relabeled UTC instead of converted. Convert timezone-aware ISO timestamps to UTC, keep the instant correct, and reject naive timestamps.

demo_solution.rationale: Replacing tzinfo changes the represented instant. astimezone preserves it, and naive inputs must be rejected explicitly.

title: URL slugs keep unsafe separators
issue: The slug helper leaves punctuation, accents, duplicate dashes, and leading or trailing separators in URLs. Normalize accented Latin characters to ASCII, lowercase, collapse non-alphanumeric runs to one dash, and strip edge dashes.

demo_solution.after:
import re
    import unicodedata
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_title.lower()).strip("-")
demo_solution.rationale: Unicode normalization removes accent marks; a single separator rule handles whitespace and punctuation consistently.
